title: Hello Charlie
desc: Charlie, a young man, is tasked with transporting a gorilla to Diu, unaware that it is a fraudster in a costume. Chaos erupts after Charlie encounters a real gorilla on their journey.

title: Khiladi
desc: A group of four friends decide to play a prank involving the fake kidnapping of one of them and asking for ransom from her father. However, things become complicated when she actually ends up dead.

title: Jai Ho
desc: A former Indian military officer devises a unique plan to promote social responsibility amongst apathetic civilians. The masses embrace his initiative, but he must confront a potent political family.

title: Jaan
desc: A top cop hires a man to guard his grandchild, unaware of the lurking threat. However, this protector is a hitman sent by kin to bump off the successor and grab the hefty estate.

title: Kundan
desc: Thakur Shamsher Singh, a wealthy criminal, tries to befriend a newly-appointed police officer in order to gain his favour, only to find out that the policeman is immune to his tactics.

title: Ravan Raaj: A True Story
desc: Former ACP Arjun Verma is reinstated to investigate the abductions of a few women in the city. To his horror, he discovers the skeletal remains of the abducted women.
